about: The code examples of the chapter 2 deck, in the order of the code slides (order = slide order). The page's chapter-code tab lists them by NAME in this order; every example is self-contained and runs with the Python standard library only (the match examples need Python 3.10 or newer); the expected result is what the run printed. The code is exactly the text of the deck's code boxes with the '>>> ' prompt removed; an indented line keeps its indentation.

page_requirements: The Python standard library only: the built-ins print, type, bool, int, len, repr and round; the match statement needs Python 3.10 or newer

examples.name: The conditional expression
match and case
examples.code:
for status in (200, 403, 418):
    match status:
        case 200:
            print(status, 'ok')
        case 401 | 403 | 404:
            print(status, 'not allowed')
        case _:
            print(status, 'other')

examples.name: match with sequences
examples.code:
commands = [['go', 'north'], ['quit'], ['dance']]
for command in commands:
    match command:
        case ['go', direction]:
            print('going', direction)
        case ['quit']:
            print('bye')
        case _:
            print('unknown', command)

examples.name: match with a guard
examples.code:
for point in ((3, 3), (3, 4)):
    match point:
        case (x, y) if x == y:
            print('diagonal at', x)
        case (x, y):
            print('elsewhere', x, y)
